transactions_debt_principal_shape.name: transactions_debt_principal_shape
transactions_debt_principal_shape.value: "transactions"."debt_role" IS DISTINCT FROM 'principal' OR ("transactions"."type" <> 'transfer' AND "transactions"."category_id" IS NULL)

transactions_transfer_shape.name: transactions_transfer_shape
transactions_transfer_shape.value: "transactions"."type" <> 'transfer' OR ("transactions"."to_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."category_id" IS NULL AND "transactions"."to_account_id" <> "transactions"."account_id")

transactions_non_transfer_shape.name: transactions_non_transfer_shape
transactions_non_transfer_shape.value: "transactions"."type" = 'transfer' OR ("transactions"."to_account_id" IS NULL AND "transactions"."to_amount" IS NULL)

debts_cash_shape.name: debts_cash_shape
debts_cash_shape.value: "debts"."origin" <> 'cash' OR ("debts"."disbursement_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL AND "debts"."origin_transaction_id" IS NULL AND "debts"."category_id" IS NULL)

debts_split_shape.name: debts_split_shape
debts_split_shape.value: "debts"."origin" <> 'split' OR ("debts"."direction" = 'receivable' AND "debts"."origin_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL AND "debts"."disbursement_transaction_id" IS NULL AND "debts"."category_id" IS NULL)

debts_purchase_shape.name: debts_purchase_shape
debts_purchase_shape.value: "debts"."origin" <> 'purchase' OR ("debts"."direction" = 'payable' AND "debts"."category_id" IS NOT NULL AND "debts"."disbursement_transaction_id" IS NULL AND "debts"."origin_transaction_id" IS NULL)
